name: Intro
lines: Yeah!

We got that sunshine
Let it ride, let it ride
Here we go!
Let it ride, let it ride

name: Verse 1
lines: Wake up, fresh cut, sun through the shade
New day, new way, got moves to make
Step to the curb with a bounce in my walk
Whole crew laughing while we kick that talk
No stress, no mess, let the good times roll
Got a little bit of funk and a whole lotta soul
From the front to the back, everybody get loose
When the beat hit hard, ain’t no need for excuse
I got rhythm in my feet, got a rhyme in my head
Good vibes only, that’s enough said
City getting hot but the flow stay cool
Old-school flavor with a brand-new rule
Keep it moving, never losing that swing
Everybody outside, let the whole block sing
If you’re feeling alright, put your hands up high
We ain’t worried ’bout tomorrow, we just let it ride

name: Chorus
lines: Let it ride, let it ride
Put your hands in the sky
Feel the rhythm, feel the vibe
We can do this all night
Let it ride, let it ride
Ain’t no worries on my mind
Sun is shining, feeling right
Come on, baby, let it ride

name: Verse 2
lines: Back on the move with a skip in the step
Beat so clean make you break your neck
Bassline walking like it owns the street
Snare hit sharp while I’m riding the beat
Left side, right side, everybody bounce
Good times coming and they coming by the ounce
No velvet rope, everybody gets in
All you gotta bring is a smile and a friend
I flip words quick with a twist and a turn
Drop one line, let the whole thing burn
Not too heavy, keep the rhythm real light
Like a cool little breeze on a Saturday night
From the rooftop down to the avenue
Everybody got something they wanna do
So forget that clock, we got nothing to prove
If the beat feels good, then you gotta move

Yeah!

lines: Now I’m back with the bounce and the summertime sound

Quick with the tongue but I’m smooth with the pace
Big old grin with the bass in your face
We don’t need much, just a beat and a crew
Blue sky overhead and a fresh point of view
Every little problem can wait outside
Right now, right here, we just let it ride
So clap two times when the snare comes through
If you’re feeling this groove, then you know what to do
